interface: verify(profile: str, uart_text: str, panel_frames: list, sensor_captures: list, controller_snapshots: list) -> dict; raises RuntimeError on any missing, malformed or failing required observation

result_policy.status: PASS only after all actual consumer observations below satisfy the oracle; no default, fixture-summary-only or source-only success
result_policy.combined_acceptance: Runner MUST independently validate an actual renewed memory-qualification receipt for the SAME final QEMU binary SHA256, STANDARD prepared-source fingerprint and runtime-manifest identity: all twelve memory qtest cases plus real ordinary SDK CPU/GDMA C2M/M2C behavior. Reject stale/different-prefix/memory-only source receipts. Oracle consumer PASS alone is not combined qualification.
result_policy.hash_policy: Panel SHA256 and source FNV1a32/FNV1a64/SHA256 derive from actual collected byte windows. Generation/epoch are identity, never artifact hashes.
result_policy.output: Compact per-frame hashes, observed callback/ownership facts and required observation counters; no embedded image bytes or synthetic trace data. Runner preserves full raw JSON, binary files, UART and HMP/QMP transcripts.

same_binary_memory_receipt.validated_by: run-lcd-cam-consumers.py --memory-qualification-receipt; consumed before combined acceptance, not fabricated by pure oracle
same_binary_memory_receipt.qtest: Actual {command:list,environment:{QTEST_QEMU_BINARY:path},binary_sha256,source_sha256,returncode:0,stdout:{path,sha256},stderr:{path,sha256}}; twelve canonical Xtensa memory TAP case names all successful, matching current final binary and complete STANDARD prepared target hashes
same_binary_memory_receipt.sdk_consumers: Exactly FOUR (idf_profile,mode) rows: idf-5.5.5/idf-6.1 times internal/psram; each {idf_profile,mode,result:{path,sha256},uart_logs:[{path,sha256}]}. Real ordinary results bind current QEMU artifact hash/source identity, locked SDKcommit and compiled firmware provenance. Existing run-native-fixture.validate_uart checks every retained real UART using its actual mode for CPU/GDMA/cache source bytes and actual DMA success/error states.
same_binary_memory_receipt.additional_required_gates: Runner receipt also binds actual SPI transport before/after evidence and all three actual boot-control evidence rows using its final documented schema; these are independently executed prerequisite evidence, never consumer UART summaries or old-prefix substitutes.
same_binary_memory_receipt.negative_policy: Missing raw logs, test failures, changed binary/source/runtime identity, authored SOURCE_READY, or older memory-only preparation are hard failures. No qualification receipt has been executed by this authoring worker.

independent_reference.jpeg_dependency: ../lcd-cam/reference/requirements.txt: Pillow>=11.3.0,<13; missing decoder is a hard failure, never marker-only fallback
prohibited: reconstructed expected bytes used as actual capture

caller_inputs.uart_text: Complete actual UART from fresh boot through LCDCAM END, preserving all fixture/API/error records. The shared literal idf banner is NOT SDK provenance.

item.rgb888: Python bytes joined only from actual QOM hex windows
item.windows: All exact raw framebuffer-json windows in offset order
item.capture: Exact capture-json dictionary containing the selected retained frame metadata

panel_frames.required: Full 9216-byte64x48 RGB888 snapshots for formula frame0 and frame1 in double mode, frame0 in bounce; actual stable1000ns and2000ns PCLK captures in both. Metadata SHA alone never substitutes for unavailable old bytes. Every provided snapshot is validated; malformed/invisible/electrical-error/mixed-cadence snapshots are not silently filtered.
panel_frames.lease: Only latest or already-frozen physical bytes are obtainable; ring eviction/unavailable frame bytes cannot be ignored or reconstructed. Exact capture.frames row must bind the framebuffer snapshot.

item.metadata: Exact count0 capture-json lease metadata or exact first actual byte-window dictionary
item.data: Python bytes joined only from actual capture-json bytes lists
item.windows: All exact raw capture-json windows, contiguous4096-byte maximum windows including actual timestamps_ns
item.lease_status: Exact stopped status-json sensor row for component_id D

sensor_captures.required: At least four chronological actual completed emissions; QQVGA RGB565/YUV422 exact38400 bytes or JPEG0<len<=278528. Same config identity/power epoch/generation, no duplicate frame, exact source scene/crop/register-mode ordering and actual DVP latch cadence.
sensor_captures.lease: Runner stops actual QEMU at a real completed emission for every full-frame window collection. No copying lease assumption, generation hash, clock_step or payload injection. All immutable fields must remain equal across windows; metadata/frame hash must equal actual collected bytes.

controller_snapshots.shape: Chronological exact LCD_CAM status-json fields at root; append only _host_observation with actual stopped UART prefix and read-only HMP register/descriptor observations

host_shape.uart_prefix: Actual complete UART prefix read at this pause; must be chronological prefix of final uart_text

gdma.channels: All five IN and all five OUT channel objects, no omitted channel

channel_shape.descriptors: Bounded complete internal walk <=1024 objects each with address:uint and words:[DW0,DW1,DW2]; optional derived fields ignored

controller_snapshots.read_only_transport: Actual HMP xp physical reads with raw commands/replies retained. No fabricated QOM trace property. MMIO base0x6003f000 +channel*0xc0 +OUT0x60; conf0/conf1/int_raw0/4/8, LINK0x20, STATE0x24, successfulEOF0x28, DSCR0x30,BF0x34,BF1x38,PERI_SEL0x48. Never POP/PUSH, W1C or register writes.
controller_snapshots.descriptor_encoding: LINK root=(0x3fc00000|(link&0xfffff)); PARK INbit24/OUTbit23. DW0 sizebits0..11,length12..23,err_eof28,suc_eof30,owner31; DW1 actual payload CPU-alias address; DW2 internal next descriptor or0. All nonzero DW2 nodes must be present in full bounded walk. Read root/trail/EOF while allocated; skip freed descriptor walks after actual delete/deinit.
controller_snapshots.required: Initial-before-CPU plus actual live/final snapshots. Nonzero actual fulfilled LCD OUT words/EOF or CAM IN bytes>=four guest buffers/completedframes>=4; controller errors fatal. Live readouts must show actual peri5 and both public consumer payload spans. External camera IN actual node3840(raw)/1024(JPEG), actual16/32/64 block alignment, internal descriptors, direct external DW1 and completed owner0 observations for both slots. Actual pre-first-return CAM_TWO_HELD UART-prefix pause must show all peri5 IN parked. After both real recovery records actual CAM bytes/frames must advance beyond held pause. No private camera struct access.
controller_snapshots.bounds: FIFO32 bytes; no nonzero RX overflow, invalid edges, dropped frames, LCD underflow, GDMA DSCR_ERR or IN_ERR_EOF accepted. Lifetime counters cannot regress.

image_rules.rgb: frame f=0/1: (((x+3*f)&31)<<11)|(((3*y+f)&63)<<5)|((x^y^f)&31); independent RGB565-LE source FNV and normalized RGB888 exact full-byte comparison/SHA. Wire line74 clocks,54lines,3996 PCLK samples; stable1MHz/500kHz frame durations3996000/7992000ns.

image_rules.camera_jpeg: Bounded baseline8-bit three-component single-scan160x120 SOF0/scan/entropy/EOI validation by independent primary parser. Pillow must really entropy-decode actual captured compressed bytes; compare known color-bars with max channel error12/mean3. Guest software fmt2rgb888 success and observed57600-byte output hash/tags are distinct evidence. No exact guest decoded pixel comparison from hash alone.

explicit_unclaimed_stronger_rows: Static repeated color-bars do not uniquely identify a guest source frame without independent guest/virtual timebase binding. Oracle retains actual source candidate frame IDs rather than inventing a unique source identity.

Two-held PARK/completed owner0/direct descriptor/public ownership/recovery observations qualify the named producer relationship, but isolated snapshots cannot prove absence of every identical-value write between observations. No continuous write-address trace is fabricated.
Guest JPEG decoded RGB888 bytes are not provided by these firmware markers; guest entropy decoder execution/source/cache relationship is qualified, not byte-exact independently decoded guest output.
Stable captured PCLK cadence qualifies actual divider behavior; exact guest API-to-physical VSYNC/restart time binding and silicon timing are not inferred without independent timebase evidence.

External CPU aliases and host HMP address observations alone cannot prove shared physical SSI/cache backing. Only renewed same-final-binary independent memory qualification can bind this inherited functional invariant.
